identificationModule.briefTitle: 177Lu-PSMA as a Systemic Adjuvant Treatment in Patients With High and Very High Risk Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: 177Lu-PSMA as a Systemic Adjuvant Treatment in Patients With High- and Very High-risk Prostate Cancer After Radical Treatment Using Locoregional Teleradiotherapy and Hormone Therapy

leadSponsor.name: Maria Sklodowska-Curie National Research Institute of Oncology

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Single-center, non-commercial phase 2 clinical trial to evaluate 177Lu-PSMA as a systemic adjuvant treatment in patients with high and very high risk prostate cancer after radical treatment using locoregional teleradiotherapy and hormone therapy
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
The intervention will consist of a single administration of 177Lu-PSMA in the research arm. Both the study and control groups will receive standard hormone therapy.

The study population includes 200 adult men with high-risk or very high-risk prostate cancer, with no signs of cancer dissemination in radiological examinations after completion of radiotherapy and continued hormone therapy

Participation time in the Study:

intervention phase - 1 day; observation phase - 5 years

armGroups.label: Experimental
armGroups.description: The intervention will consist of a single administration of 177Lu-PSMA with an activity of 7.4 GBq. Participants will also receive standard hormone therapy

armGroups.label: Control
armGroups.description: Participants will receive standard hormone therapy

interventions.name: Lutetium (177Lu) vipivotide tetraxetan
interventions.description: The intervention will consist of a single administration of 7,4 GBq of lutetium (177Lu) vipivotide tetraxetan

primaryOutcomes.description: Assessment of treatment failure - the assesment of biochemical progression ratio, defined as a rise of PSA by 2 ng/mL or more above the nadir, proven by a consecutive examination performed at least 4 weeks later
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 2 and 5 years after end of treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparative assessment of biochemical progression-free survival time defined as an increase in tPSA (prostate specific antigen) in the blood above the nadir (the lowest PSA value after completion of treatment) by 2 ng/mL or more, confirmed in the next test performed no earlier than after 4 weeks
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: During the intervention and follow up period (assessed up to 5 years)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparative assessment of radiological progression-free survival defined according to PCWG3 criteria
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: During the intervention and follow up period (assessed up to 5 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time until the next therapeutic intervention
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparative assessment of the time until the next therapeutic intervention
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: During the intervention and follow up period (assessed up to 5 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events according to CTCAE v 5.0
secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparative assessment of safety and tolerability of treatment according to CTCAE v 5.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: During the intervention and follow up period (assessed up to 5 years)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Comparison of EORTC QLQ-PR25 quality of life indicators between study groups

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Giving a written informed consent
* Histopathologically confirmed high or very high risk prostate cancer
* Completion of radical locoregional treatment
* Completion of locoregional treatment within 3 months before inclusion to the study
* ECOG performance status 0 to 2
* Age over 18 years
* Within 28 days before entering the study, there were no signs of cancer dissemination documented in radiological tests
* Castrate testosterone level (testosteron \< 50 ng/dL lub 1,7 nmol/L)
* Patients with adequate function of main organs:

  * bone marrow:

    * neutrophils \> 1500x10\^9/L;
    * thrombocytes \> 100,000x10\^9/L;
    * hemoglobin \> 9 g/dL
  * liver:

    * bilirubin \< 2xULN (upper limit of normal) in patients with Gilbert's syndrome \< 5xULN;
    * aminotransferase \< 3xULN
  * kidneys:

    * eGFR \> 50 ml/min
    * albumin \>2.5 mg/ml
* For men of reproductive age: the need to use double barrier contraception

Exclusion Criteria:

* The presence of distant metastases confirmed by radiological examination
* Absence of approval to use effective contraception method
* Absence of Patient's consent to participate in the Study
* Urinary tract obstruction or/and hydronephrosis.
* Concurrent anticancer treatment.
